envVars.name: BRIDGE_AGENT_CONTEXT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Optional timeout for gathering agent context before local model execution.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_AGENT_NATIVE_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Controls whether local agent runs include native Cursor context gathered before model execution.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_AGENT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
envVars.description: Public origin advertised to Cursor Agent clients when different from the bridge public origin.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_AGENT_RUN_SSE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Optional timeout for waiting on pending Agent RunSSE/Bidi state.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_AGENT_TOOL_POLICY
envVars.description: Controls whether local agent runs advertise only safe tools or the approved extended tool set.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_AGENT_TOOL_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Optional timeout for waiting on Cursor exec tool results during local agent runs.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token required to protect non-localhost bridge binds unless explicitly bypassed.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_CAPTURE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for traffic captures when capture mode is enabled.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_CAPTURE_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enables explicit traffic capture hooks; route inventory is separate.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_CERT_PATH

envVars.description: Path to TLS certificate material.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_DESKTOP_AGENT_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Optional secondary HTTP listener port for desktop agent compatibility experiments.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_DESKTOP_MODE
envVars.description: Enables desktop proxy defaults, including upstream, public origin, TLS hostnames, and route inventory.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_EXTENSION_SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Optional timeout for local extension/plugin setup during bridge startup.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_FAIL_OPEN
envVars.description: Controls whether typed intercept failures return explicit bridge errors after consuming request bodies.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_HARDCODED_RESPONSE

envVars.name: BRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Bridge log level: debug, info, warn, or error.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_LOG_MODEL_PAYLOADS
envVars.description: Controls local model payload logging; full payload logging is explicit opt-in.

envVars.name: BRIDGE_MAX_INTERCEPT_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum buffered body size for typed intercept routes.
